meta.description: Knowledge graph for the ManiSkill PlugCharger task: a Franka Panda (panda_wristcam, 7 arm joints + parallel gripper, base at world [-0.615,0,0]) grasps a small charger (two pegs) and plugs it into a wall receptacle. A high-precision insertion task. Consumed by the P4-LLM reasoning + prescription components to ground failure analysis and the prescribed correction config (charger_pose + receptacle_pose) the expert must solve. World-frame metres; prescriptions MUST stay inside the stated ranges or the expert cannot solve them and the round is wasted.
meta.control_mode: pd_joint_pos (policy acts in rel_joint_pos = 7 joint deltas + 1 gripper command)

properties.role: grasp it and insert its pegs into the receptacle
the charger pegs must be inserted into its two holes; defines the goal pose
grasps the charger; aligns it to the receptacle for insertion
properties.approach_matters: insertion needs sub-cm alignment of peg to hole

properties.extra_goal_pose: target charger pose at full insertion

properties.note: charger spawns flat on the table, z-rotation in +/- pi/3
receptacle mounted upright, z-rotation around pi +/- pi/8

properties.expert_action: panda motion planner → grasp/align/insert (recorded as the same 8-dim demo)

properties.metric: charger pose matches the goal (peg fully in receptacle) within position+orientation thresholds AND robot static

properties.description: Gripper fails to secure the small charger (off-centre or slips).
Charger is grasped and brought to the receptacle but the peg is not aligned with the hole; insertion fails (the dominant, high-precision failure).
Peg enters the hole but is not pushed to full depth / correct orientation, so the goal-pose match fails.
Charger/arm collides with the receptacle face or wall, displacing the charger or jamming.
Episode reaches the step horizon without success (hesitation, repeated alignment attempts).
carry the charger toward the receptacle
align the peg with the receptacle hole (high precision)
push the peg to full depth and hold static

reasoning_implications.missed_grasp: Prescribe a charger_pose with a clean, well-inside-bounds grasp approach so the demo teaches secure grasping of the small charger first.
reasoning_implications.misaligned_insert: Prescribe a config where the charger starts closer to / better oriented toward the receptacle (smaller required re-orientation) so the demo emphasises the peg-to-hole alignment that is the dominant failure.
reasoning_implications.partial_insert: Prescribe a config that ends in full insertion so the demo teaches pushing the peg to full depth with the correct orientation, not a shallow stop.
reasoning_implications.collision: Prescribe charger/receptacle poses that leave a collision-free approach corridor so the demo teaches insertion without striking the receptacle face.
reasoning_implications.timeout: Prescribe poses well inside the reliable ranges with a direct grasp-transport-align-insert path (no repeated alignment oscillation).
reasoning_implications.workspace_constraint: Every prescribed config MUST keep charger_xyz within x[-0.10,-0.026] y[-0.20,0.20] z=0.012 (zrot in +/- 1.047 rad) and receptacle_xyz within x[0.01,0.10] y[-0.10,0.10] z=0.10 (zrot in [2.749,3.534] rad) and tcp within x[-0.35,0.35] y[-0.35,0.35] z[0.02,0.30]; out-of-range poses are infeasible and waste the round.
reasoning_implications.non_emptiness: A failure is present, so the prescription MUST be a concrete, fully-specified config (non-empty charger_xyz, charger_zrot, receptacle_xyz). Never emit an empty prescription.
